name: Audit Metabob Integration
description: Comprehensive audit of Metabob tool integration: identifies unused high-value tools, checks codebase indexing status, validates annotation coverage, and generates actionable improvement report

task_steps.description: Test Metabob MCP connectivity and list all available tools

prompt.template:
Test Metabob MCP connectivity and identify all available tools:

1. Run test_metabob_mcp to verify connection and list all 35 tools
2. Categorize tools by function:
   - Code Quality (search_codebase_issues, get_priority_issues, mark_problem_complete)
   - Component Analysis (list_file_components, analyze_change_impact, assess_deletion_safety, metabob_find_similar_components)
   - Design Decisions (annotate_component, check_for_existing_functionality)
   - Activity Management (search_activities, activity, create_activity_template, evolve_activity_template)
   - Session Tracking (metabob_record_session_start, metabob_record_session_complete, metabob_record_tool_invocation)
   - Change Prediction (suggest_related_changes, assess_pattern_quality)
   - Monitoring (get_metabob_status, get_next_step)
3. Create a markdown report with tool categories and current integration status

task_steps.description: Analyze current Metabob tool usage in codebase

prompt.template:
Analyze current Metabob tool usage across the codebase:

1. Search for all metabob tool invocations:
   - Search repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/ for metabob_ references
   - Categorize by: agent prompts, session management, template execution, tool implementations
2. Identify usage patterns:
   - Which tools are heavily used (>10 references)
   - Which tools are moderately used (3-10 references)
   - Which tools are lightly used (1-2 references)
   - Which tools are never used (0 references)
3. Create detailed markdown report with:
   - Usage statistics per tool
   - High-value unused tools
   - Integration gaps
   - Files/modules that should be using more tools

task_steps.description: Check codebase indexing status and coverage

prompt.template:
Verify Metabob codebase indexing and coverage:

1. Check if codebase is properly indexed:
   - Try metabob_search_codebase_issues with a simple query
   - Check for any indexing errors or warnings
2. Test component discovery:
   - Use list_file_components on key files (activity.ts, session.ts, template-executor.ts)
   - Verify component extraction is working
3. Test change impact analysis:
   - Use analyze_change_impact on a core component
   - Verify dependency graph is populated
4. Create markdown report with:
   - Indexing status (healthy/degraded/failed)
   - Coverage statistics (files indexed, components discovered)
   - Any issues preventing proper indexing
   - Recommendations for improvement

task_steps.description: Validate annotation coverage for design decisions

prompt.template:
Audit design decision annotation coverage:

1. Identify key components that should have annotations:
   - Core session management (Session, SessionState, SessionManager)
   - Activity execution (ActivityExecutor, TemplateExecutor)
   - Tool implementations (activity.ts, edit.ts, write.ts)
   - Agent definitions (activity.txt, review.txt, orchestrator.txt)
2. Check which components have annotations using grep/ripgrep
3. Test annotation retrieval:
   - Search for existing annotations in a known file
4. Calculate annotation coverage:
   - Total key components: ~50
   - Components with annotations: ?
   - Coverage percentage
5. Create markdown report with:
   - Annotation coverage statistics
   - High-priority components missing annotations
   - Examples of good vs missing annotations
   - Action items for improving coverage

Validate Metabob change prediction tools:

1. Test suggest_related_changes:
   - Pick a recently modified file (e.g., activity.ts)
   - Call suggest_related_changes to see if co-change patterns are working
   - Verify recommendations are relevant
2. Test check_for_existing_functionality (if available):
   - Query for existing implementations of common patterns
   - Verify it helps prevent duplicate code
3. Test assess_pattern_quality:
   - Analyze a known code pattern
   - Check if quality assessment is meaningful
4. Create markdown report with:
   - Change prediction tool status (working/not working)
   - Quality of predictions (accurate/needs tuning)
   - Recommendations for improvement
   - Integration opportunities in workflow

task_steps.description: Generate comprehensive improvement report and action plan

prompt.template:
Synthesize all audit findings into comprehensive improvement report:

1. Consolidate findings from all tasks:
   - Tool connectivity and availability
   - Current usage patterns (26% used, 74% unused)
   - Indexing and coverage status
   - Annotation gaps
   - Change prediction capabilities
2. Prioritize high-value improvements:
   - CRITICAL: Tools that should be integrated immediately
   - HIGH: Tools that would significantly improve workflow
   - MEDIUM: Nice-to-have integrations
   - LOW: Tools for future consideration
3. Create detailed action plan:
   - Phase 1: Fix indexing issues (if any)
   - Phase 2: Integrate high-value unused tools
   - Phase 3: Improve annotation coverage
   - Phase 4: Enable change prediction in workflows
4. Generate final report as METABOB_INTEGRATION_AUDIT_REPORT.md with:
   - Executive Summary
   - Current State Assessment
   - Gap Analysis
   - Prioritized Action Plan
   - Implementation Roadmap
   - Success Metrics
